details: Click Refresh 2026 on Tracking in Excel desktop for Windows. Allow the workbook’s macro when Excel prompts. Save as .xlsm.
Downloads current conference standings and results, removes duplicate reports, updates base and adjusted estimates, preserves outreach fields and saves a backup.
Several minutes are normal. The status line names the source being read. Keep Excel open until it reports completion.
The refresh program is embedded in this workbook and uses Windows PowerShell. No Python or separate companion file is required.
Column B is the fixed 2025 NCAA rank. Column F is the adjusted 2026 estimate; G is the base rank. Neither 2026 column is an official NCAA release.

Base RPI = 25% D1 win percentage + 50% opponents’ win percentage + 25% opponents’ opponents’ win percentage. Separate bonuses and penalties use current base-rank bands and editable assumptions on RPI rules.
https://ncaaorg.s3.amazonaws.com/championships/sports/volleyball/d1/women/2025-26D1WVB_PreChampsManual.pdf

Overall and conference standings are copied as published. Tracking E shows the conference win–loss record and does not feed the RPI calculation. Overall standings differences are visible in Tracking U and RPI calculation O.
Use the standardized school name when entering notes. LSU New Orleans is linked to its 2025 NCAA name New Orleans. Source aliases are visible in School names.
West Florida is included in the 2026 D1 field. Saint Francis remains for its 2025 rank and outreach history, with no 2026 D1 estimate.
https://goargos.com/news/2026/8/26/womens-volleyball-uwf-volleyball-selected-8th-in-asun-preseason-poll.aspx | https://www.francis.edu/D3TransitionFAQ
Non-D1 games do not affect base RPI. Losses to non-D1 schools can incur adjustment penalties. Only reviewed non-NCAA opponents count in the weak nonconference schedule share.

NCAA Division II membership directory: https://web3.ncaa.org/directory/memberList?division=II&type=12 | Rutgers-Camden: https://www.rutgers.edu/athletics | Montreat: https://montreatcavaliers.com/sports/2021/11/24/quick-facts
The refresh stops and reports the school requiring review. It never silently treats an unmatched name as a non-D1 team.
Match date, both standardized schools and set score identify a duplicate report. Dates are converted to the game’s local time. Conflicting scores stop the refresh for review.
If the same schools play more than once on the same day, those games require a separate match identifier and review before refreshing.

Two reviewed match-specific corrections are retained: Jacksonville’s Aug. 29 opponent is Southern Miss., and Arkansas-Pine Bluff’s Sept. 5 opponent is Division II Missouri S&T. Evidence is recorded in Matches.
An estimate depends on the completeness of the published match feeds. All 32 conference feeds were read; the checks below compare results with their standings.
A copy is saved before a refresh changes data. Local workbooks use a backups folder beside the workbook; cloud paths use Documents/NIVC RPI Backups.
If a website changes or returns incomplete data, the saved rankings and notes are retained and the error appears in Tracking A6.

Standings say 6-5; completed results say 7-4. Temple’s recap confirms the Sept. 11 win over New Haven. https://owlsports.com/news/2026/9/11/womens-volleyball-owls-make-strong-statement-in-match-two-of-bearcat-classic

Standings say 3-8; completed results say 4-7. The Sept. 19 recap confirms the win over UCSB. https://ucdavisaggies.com/news/2026/9/19/womens-volleyball-aggies-wrap-up-non-conference-play-in-four-set-win-against-ucsb.aspx

Standings say 3-7; completed results say 2-8. Loyola’s recap confirms the Sept. 4 loss to Towson. https://loyolagreyhounds.com/news/2026/9/4/womens-volleyball-volleyball-rallies-against-towson-but-tigers-hold-on-for-win.aspx

Chicago State: 0-8 published / 0-12 results. Delaware State: 9-2 / 9-5. Western Kentucky: 6-5 / 6-6. Portland: 8-2 / 7-2; its WCC schedule lists the Portland State win twice. These notes describe the initial Sept. 21 snapshot; current flags recalculate.
